what: Free talk (open-vocabulary English lip reading), Auto-AVSR vsr_trlrs2lrs3vox2avsp_base (250 M params, 20.3% WER on LRS3 per its authors), zero-shot on GRID speaker s1
data: GRID corpus, Zenodo record 3625687 (CC BY 4.0), speaker s1, 30 random clips (seed 0); transcripts from the clip names
caveats: GRID is voiced speech with a fixed nonsense grammar (command colour preposition LETTER DIGIT adverb), 360x288 video: out of domain for an LRS3-trained model and no help from language context. Not silent mouthing, not our users. Not comparable to LRS3 numbers.
